verdicts.reason: A is just the original shrunk to a tiny strip in the middle of the canvas, with large dead areas on both sides. The quote and the G.M. ALLEN button are a few pixels tall and can't be read, so the layout was never rearranged. B does rearrange it into a banner and the quote is readable, but it is badly broken: the quote-mark glyphs are blown up into huge dark blocks that crowd and touch the headline, the author box is stretched into an oversized empty frame with tiny text, a stray empty square floats between the elements, and the photo's white frame is lost.
